precision_note: Coordinates are deliberately obfuscated: each point is displaced along a fixed pseudo-random bearing and rounded to 3 decimal places, putting every published marker 41-165 m from its true position (median 94 m). Marker positions are approximate by design and cannot be used to navigate to a sensor or to infer where any individual animal was detected.
popup_note: Hovering a marker lists every species recorded by that sensor and how many times. Parallel-camera tallies belong to the individual camera station; AHDriFT and ARU tallies belong to the plot, which carries one array and one recorder respectively.
